test_name: Text clef anchored by cnb:clef-anchor-semitones, linear staff (session 24)
description: A 'text clef whose label is a filled 1x2 path markup, sized at cnb:clef-size-semitones 4 (2 staff-spaces) and anchored at cnb:clef-anchor-semitones 15.5, on the default sps-2 staff with the treble context (middleCPosition -6). The anchor takes the 'custom clef's path: semitone 15.5 is (15.5 - 12) / 2 = +1.75 staff-spaces above the staff center, so the label's TOP edge must sit 1.75 staff-spaces above center_y (a quarter space under the top line) and its bottom edge 2 staff-spaces lower. A path label harvests its outline, where a string label harvests a 0x0 text anchor. Measured 2026-11-10 on 2.24: top edge y = 8.296 against center_y 10.05 (expected 8.30).

assertions.description: The text clef is engraved in measure 1

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: THE LABEL'S TOP EDGE AT THE ANCHOR SEMITONE ===

assertions.description: The label's TOP edge lands at semitone 15.5 = 1.75 staff-spaces above the staff center (fractional anchor, linear formula with middleCPosition)
The label keeps its size: 4 semitones at sps-2 = 2 staff-spaces tall, 1 wide

assertions._comment: === SECTION 3: THE REST OF THE SCORE IS UNAFFECTED ===

assertions.description: Noteheads render normally alongside the anchored text clef
